title: Reducing Road Traffic Accidents and Fatalities Involving Motorcyclists and Pillion Riders
what_it_is: Reducing Road Traffic Accidents and Fatalities Involving Motorcyclists and Pillion Riders

sections.label: Measures for careful driving
sections.summary: The Ministry uses legislative and public education measures, including raised speeding penalties, to encourage careful driving and reduce accidents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Ministry has a range of measures, both legislative and relating to public education to encourage drivers and riders to be more careful.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Ministry has for example raised penalties for speeding, to try and reduce accidents.

sections.label: Motorcycle helmet and ABS standards
sections.summary: The Traffic Police updated motorcycle helmet standards from 1 November 2025, and LTA will require ABS on newly registered motorcycles from 1 April 2027.

sentences.text: To enhance road safety for all motorcyclists, the Traffic Police (TP) recently updated the standards for motorcycle helmets, which will take effect from 1 November 2025.
In addition, the Land Transport Authority will require all newly registered motorcycles to be equipped with an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) from 1 April 2027.

sections.label: Singapore Ride Safe campaign
sections.summary: TP launched the Singapore Ride Safe campaign with Singapore Road Safety Month 2025, reaching over 13,500 people, plus public awareness campaigns.

sentences.text: TP launched the Singapore Ride Safe campaign in conjunction with the Singapore Road Safety Month in 2025, which reached out to more than 13,500 people, and public awareness campaigns such as the "Reward the Sensible Motorist".

sections.label: Motorcyclist accident statistics
sections.summary: Mid-year statistics show motorcyclist accidents rose about 9.5% to about 2,088 in the first half of this year, with 54.7% involving motorcyclists and pillion riders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Indeed, the recent mid-year statistics on overall road accidents have indicated that the number of accidents involving motorcyclists increased about 9.5% from about 1,900 in the first half of last year, to about 2,088 in the first half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The number of motorcyclists who get involved in traffic accidents is high, and in fact they constitute a disproportionately larger proportion of overall accidents in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I quote, specifically 54.7% of accidents in the first half of 2025 involved motorcyclists and pillion riders.

sections.label: Helmet and ABS initiatives
sections.summary: The helmet standards and ABS initiatives are the newest measures being promoted to help bring accident numbers down.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: The two initiatives that we recently promoted in terms of the standards for the motorcyclist helmets, as well as the ABS are the newest initiatives that we are putting out to do our part to make sure that we bring the accident numbers down.
